project_evidence: Architected a multi‑agent pipeline using LangGraph across five specialized nodes (Triage, Supervisor, Factor, Harm, Suggestion). Implemented a Dual‑LLM routing strategy (Groq + Gemini 2.0 Flash) and an asynchronous hybrid retrieval system combining Qdrant with real‑time web scraping (SearXNG, Crawl4AI, Jina Reranker). Optimized async pipeline execution with 12 s timeout controls, eliminating deadlocks and ensuring high request‑completion reliability.

Architected an RAG pipeline using LangChain to answer corporate policy queries with tool‑calling, enabling Llama 3.2 to autonomously query FAISS or respond directly. Built semantic caching with Redis to reduce repeated LLM calls and achieve sub‑30 ms response time. Developed real‑time SSE streaming via FastAPI async generators and integrated Langfuse for tracing, prompt versioning, and automated evaluation.
